invites_email_shape.name: invites_email_shape
invites_email_shape.value: position('@' in email) > 1 and length(email) between 3 and 320

users_email_shape.name: users_email_shape
users_email_shape.value: position('@' in email) > 1 and length(email) between 3 and 320

concepts_bkt_params_range.name: concepts_bkt_params_range
concepts_bkt_params_range.value: "catalog"."concepts"."prior_mastery" between 0 and 1 and "catalog"."concepts"."learn_rate" between 0 and 1 and "catalog"."concepts"."slip_rate" between 0 and 1 and "catalog"."concepts"."guess_rate" between 0 and 1

lessons_grader_required_for_code.name: lessons_grader_required_for_code
lessons_grader_required_for_code.value: ("catalog"."lessons"."kind" not in ('lab', 'project')) or ("catalog"."lessons"."grader_key" is not null)

lesson_state_score_range.name: lesson_state_score_range
lesson_state_score_range.value: ("progress"."lesson_state"."score" is null or "progress"."lesson_state"."score" between 0 and 1) and ("progress"."lesson_state"."best_score" is null or "progress"."lesson_state"."best_score" between 0 and 1)

subscriptions_exactly_one_subject.name: subscriptions_exactly_one_subject
subscriptions_exactly_one_subject.value: ("billing"."subscriptions"."user_id" is not null) <> ("billing"."subscriptions"."org_id" is not null)

subscriptions_period_ordered.name: subscriptions_period_ordered
subscriptions_period_ordered.value: "billing"."subscriptions"."current_period_end" is null or "billing"."subscriptions"."current_period_start" is null or "billing"."subscriptions"."current_period_end" > "billing"."subscriptions"."current_period_start"

discussions_exactly_one_anchor.name: discussions_exactly_one_anchor
discussions_exactly_one_anchor.value: ("social"."discussions"."lesson_id" is not null) <> ("social"."discussions"."contest_id" is not null)
